basis: RunPod hourly billing retrieved 17 November 2026 at 18:47 UTC after both allocations were deleted. Reported charges cover GPU and disk through termination, including the failed startup; consecutive final retrievals were identical. GPU-billed hours equal GPU charges divided by the listed rate. The conservative full-lifetime estimate is separate from reported charges. Amounts are provider-reported as of retrieval.

successful_allocation_duration_crosschec.interpretation: Empirical coverage cross-check, not a provider assertion about billing latency or future adjustments.

future_provider_adjustments: Not assessed; the report records provider-reported amounts at the stated retrieval time, rather than guaranteeing a final invoice.
